script.text: High in the green hills of Bukidnon, there stands a Reading Castle. But its great lamp had grown dim.

Listen! The river says splash, and the bird says tweet!
Reading starts with good listening. Join us, Max!

script.text: A stream blocked the way. Mia built a bridge, block by block.
Letters are like blocks. Put them together to make words!
B-U-L-I-G! We can cross now!

script.text: Then Kai came running with a letter from the Reading Castle.
Message for everyone: the great lamp is almost out!
Oh no! We must hurry!

script.text: The storm broke the bridge to the castle. Then a new friend came: Bob the Builder!
Do not worry! I have a plan. I will build it again, better than before!
Hooray! Now we can reach the great lamp!
